# Lighthouse Law

> Lighthouse Law is a professional law firm in Vietnam providing comprehensive legal services for individuals and businesses.

## About

Lighthouse Law offers 12 areas of legal services including legal consultation, intellectual property, investment & business advisory, corporate law, real estate law, civil law, criminal law, family & marriage law, labor law, tax law, contract drafting, and dispute resolution. We serve both Vietnamese and international clients in Vietnamese and English.
